title: Initialize Firebase v9+
description: Basic setup for Firebase in a web application.
explanation_md: Shows how to initialize the Firebase SDK (Modular v9+) and get a reference to the Firestore database.

title: Firestore Realtime Listener
description: Subscribe to changes in a collection.
explanation_md: The `onSnapshot` listener triggers every time the specified collection changes, providing real-time updates.

title: Email/Password Authentication
description: Creating a new user with email and password.
explanation_md: A straightforward way to register new users using the Firebase Auth module.

title: Upload File to Storage
description: Upload a file with a progress listener.
explanation_md: Uses `uploadBytesResumable` to track the progress of a file upload and retrieve the public download URL once finished.

title: Call a Cloud Function
description: Triggering a Firebase Cloud Function from the client.
explanation_md: HttpsCallable allows you to call backend logic securely from your frontend code without managing traditional API endpoints.
